reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: reduce_outflow has 2 active non-test callers in market.move (lines 298, 483). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack path is through public user-callable deposit/repay entry points (untrusted). Gate 3: limiter.move is explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the deposit entry point by withdrawing tokens in one time segment and then depositing in a later segment after the segment boundary, causing reduce_outflow to zero out the wrong (current) segment while the original withdrawal segment remains inflated, blocking all subsequent withdrawals until the original segment naturally expires after a full cycle duration.
